Name: New Crop Recipes
Author: larkylovesyou2
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Every time I play Stardew, I end up staring longingly at the carrots, summer squash, broccoli, and powdermelons that I've grown and wishing I could do something with them. So I decided to make them some cooking recipes! Yes, it's entirely normal to feel bad for pixel produce. Don't judge me.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Adds 3 new recipes for each of the seasonal crops:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]Carrots: [/b]Carrot Cake, Honey-Glazed Carrots, & Carrot Ginger Soup[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]Summer Squash:[/b] Squash Casserole, Ratatouille, & Squash Fritters[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]Broccoli: [/b]Broccoli Cheese Soup, Broccoli Salad, & Green Smoothie[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]Powdermelon:[/b] Powdermelon Punch, Powdermelon Chili, & Powder-Pop[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8]All of the recipes can be purchased from the Saloon for 500g each.[/color]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]This mod is fully compatible with any other mods that may add similar cooking recipes.[/*]
[*]This mod only works for Stardew Valley versions 1.6+, as the crops required for the cooking recipes are all from that update.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: New Crop Recipes
Manifest.Description: Adds cooking recipes that use the new crops from the 1.6 update.
Manifest.Author: larkylovesyou2
